text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Opera O is on fire this year!! She's 
definitely going to put on an amazing run 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's in great shape lately, 
huh? With all these rising stars, I wonder 
what'll happen to SteGo~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Auu~, it's so frustrating...! I wanted to 
run alongside Stego-san and give it my all 
together with her too~~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us treat this race as nourishment 
and prepare for what lies ahead."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. As long as we keep running 
for a long time, we'll be able to run 
together with Stay Gold-sama again~

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...The me of that other world ran for a 
long time, spanning across eras."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And so, perhaps it's because I've seen so 
many meetings and partings.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The time spent with those girls, sharing 
that unique bond of being in the same 
generation... felt surprisingly 
comforting.
choice_data_list:
...That just shows how much they meant to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This journey made me realize it all 
over again. ...I don't know about the me 
in another world, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, I quite like this 
'generation' of ours."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll go show them. The time I spent 
running with those girls.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Right then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(In my "memories," by the time I was 
racing against Opera O and the others, 
neither Bright nor Fukukitaru were running 
anymore...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Still, today—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ――Stego-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I've definitely gotten faster than last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Today, I intend to finish ahead of 
everyone else. ...Even Opera O-san. Even 
senpai.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha...! Suzuka really is just so Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah... that's right—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Here... is where you are.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we get going? Let's run wild 
and make a scene today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Both Stay Gold and Silence Suzuka 
have such incredible presence...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Opera is getting all the attention, but 
those two are definitely forces to be 
reckoned with...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohooooo...! A rare same-generation pair, 
jackpot...! And seeing them acting so 
natural together is just unbeatable...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They're both quiet, but... what incredible 
presence...! As expected...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold, Doto. Shrouded in flickering 
flames, they have appeared before this 
Overlord...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The overture of destiny has begun! Draw 
your swords! Today, on this very ground— 
the first flame leading to twilight shall 
be kindled!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I... I can't afford to lose, right...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed! Our time shall be tested. High 
in the heavens, the Valkyries must be 
watching to see how it unfolds!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —What a welcome. Truly just like you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have some fun today, Opera O. And 
while we're at it, I'll teach you a thing 
or two."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Our running, that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are the one who should engrave it! The 
brilliance of the Supreme Ruler, and the 
one who adorns his supreme path!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Nice. ——I'm getting fired up.
